questions.answer: Follow causal dependencies across input, app, renderer, buffers, composition, and display, then validate with a controlled intervention.

questions.prompt: The longest-duration slice visible near a slow frame is necessarily on that frame critical path.

questions.answer: A dependency path connects it to presentation and a controlled change predictably moves the resulting latency distribution.
